title: Zigzag line, 45.0° V, Sharp Corners button 1, Miter Limit 0 mm
description: An open Zigzag Stitch line on the 45.0° V (10,20), (50,20), (30,40) mm at PE-DESIGN's zigzag defaults, Sharp Corners button 1 and Miter Limit 0 mm (#373 part 2: the corner angle below which the two buttons sew differently): stitch count, typical and longest stitch, and the size. The width is left out: OpenStitch's button-1 cut reaches 40.4 mm against PE-DESIGN's 40.2 at 45° (0.05 over the 0.15 mm tolerance; the 29.7° V matches).
